programme.desc: After committing a robbery, Basava and his companion, John, run into Agraharam Geetha, a stranger, and the trio end up in Bhairavakona, a village shrouded in mystery.

programme.title: Saaho
programme.desc: An undercover agent and his partner go after a thief who has stolen 2,000 crore rupees. Soon, they realise that the case is linked to the death of a crime lord and an emerging gang war.

programme.title: Thunder
programme.desc: A CBI officer is addressed by a different name after he wakes up from his coma. Soon he realises that it is a trap set by the chief minister to avenge an old grudge.

programme.title: Chill Bro
programme.desc: After emigrating at a young age, a man could never spare enough time to spend with his family. However, the death of his sister causes old wounds to resurface.

programme.title: Karnan
programme.desc: Karnan, a boy from a lower-caste village, fights for the rights and dignity of his people.

programme.title: Karumegangal Kalaigindrana
programme.desc: Komagan, an advocate, defends the criminal whom his father, a judge, had convicted. Later, he finds out that he has a step-sister and strives to find her.

programme.title: Irandam Ulagaporin Kadaisi Gundu
programme.desc: Selvam, a lorry driver who works for a scrap metal yard, hopes to buy his own lorry and marry his lover Chittu. However, his dreams are disrupted when he ends up with an unexploded bomb.

programme.title: Kodiveeran
programme.desc: Kodiveeran, who enjoys a god-like stature in his village, sets out to protect his family as he battles Villangam and Adhigaaram, who pose a threat to his brother-in-law's life.

programme.title: Bhaagamathie
programme.desc: Chanchala, an IAS officer, is imprisoned in a haunted house for interrogation. However, things take an unexpected turn when she gets possessed by a spirit.

programme.title: Idhu Ennoda Jilla
programme.desc: A young man sets out to avenge his father's death but soon realises that violence is not the key to his salvation. His life changes when he meets a young woman, who helps him rediscover himself.

programme.title: Ka Pae Ranasingam
programme.desc: Ariyanachi, a poor woman, strives to bring her deceased husband's body back to India from Dubai, battling the odds of political agenda, corruption and a treacherous bureaucracy that stand in her way.

programme.title: Mr. & Mrs. Arjun
programme.desc: Arjun, a spoilt young man, is jealous of his neighbour, Anu, as she gets doted on by everyone around him. He finds out that she wishes to move abroad for higher education and decides to ruin her plan.

programme.title: Yaanai
programme.desc: Ravi, the youngest son of an influential family accused of causing a man's death, takes charge of defending them. However, amidst the turmoil, he unexpectedly falls for a woman.

programme.title: Dinosaurs
programme.desc: Dhana sacrifices his freedom by taking the blame for Durai's crimes. However, when the latter is murdered, Mannu embarks on a vengeful mission to seek justice.
